title: The Lakehouse for AI
summary: LanceDB raised a $57.5m Series B ($98.5m total) after growing revenue >10x YoY & open-source downloads 6x to 120m+. Across Exa, Runway, Microsoft AI, Adobe & NVIDIA, teams are replacing fragmented blob, Parquet & vector copies with a single multimodal lakehouse supporting 100b rows, 40b+ vectors & 8k+ GPUs training in parallel.

title: Strategic Decision or Structural Advantage?
summary: Sixteen weeks of Databricks Unity Gateway telemetry across 10,000+ enterprises show Anthropic & OpenAI splitting the market by tier. Anthropic captures 94% of frontier SOTA tokens & 70% of proprietary spend, while OpenAI captures 81% of low-end tokens & coincides with open-weight share stalling at 31% after cutting Luna prices by 90%.
